messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4242 triggered for service=hotpath-inference - alert=p99_latency > 3000ms (5m window) severity=page :rotating_light:
Maya: acked PD-4242 - I'm taking first touch. Checking dashboards and KV/cache metrics. region=us-west, model=redwood-7b-quant
Josh: :eyes: I can see p99 ~3600ms on the realtime dash. Traffic spike + KV evictions going up. No obvious ops deploy in the last 60m though.
Kevin: Not seeing deploys either. Any hotkey or prefix surge? logs look noisy for sidecar eviction loops.
Elena: ops-roles: I deployed a change earlier to eviction thresholds (lowered retention) to reduce memory. Reverting now if that's the culprit.
Maya: Running quick checks: curl to health endpoints looks fine. Running tails on sidecar:
```
2026-03-17T18:12:02Z sidecar evict: key=prefix:abcd size=1024 age=120s
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z sidecar evict: key=prefix:efgh size=980 age=121s
2026-03-17T18:12:04Z warn: kv-cache-evictions spike=78/min
```
Maya: eviction spike lines up with p99 tail. Putting eviction revert patch to staging then prod.
incident-bot: PD-4242 acknowledged by Maya (:white_check_mark:)
Josh: I'm going to enable fallback routing for hotpath traffic to redwood-3b-fallback to drop token latency while we stabilize. Executing reroute now: `/infra reroute --service hotpath --to redwood-3b-fallback --weight 30%`
Maya: Confirmed reroute command accepted. Observability: p99 has dropped from ~3600ms -> ~1400ms within 2m of reroute. Still watching.
Priya (Support Lead): Notifying customer success and support. ETA for customer-facing note in 15m. Customer impact estimate: ~2% of requests see degraded latency > threshold, some rate-limited retries observed.
Kevin: Revert of eviction threshold started by Elena. Patch applied to prod at 18:18 UTC. Will monitor eviction rate.
Elena: Revert complete. Eviction spikes decreasing on prod tails.
Maya: p99 now trending ~950ms and falling. Keeping PD open until stable 15m window. Preparing a short incident summary once we close.
Josh: Dropping autoscale burst for hotpath to reduce queueing on overloaded workers while cache warms: `/infra scale --service hotpath --burst 0.5x`
Maya: Agreed. I'll keep watch, will escalate to infra-sd if we see memory pressure.
Priya (Support Lead): Support message drafted, awaiting internal signoff.
Maya: Thanks all — mitigation in place: reroute + eviction revert + burst scaledown. Monitoring for 15m. If stable, we'll close PD and postmortem follow-up to investigate telemetry gaps and safer eviction rollouts. :thumbsup:
